title: "U-2 photography of Egyptian airbase at Almaza, 29 October 1956" (Chapter 3, p. 119)
description: Black-and-white U-2 aerial reconnaissance photograph of an airbase, showing runways, taxiways and surrounding terrain. Captioned "U-2 photography of Egyptian airbase at Almaza, 29 October 1956." The text describes before-and-after photography of Almaza during the Suez Crisis and Eisenhower's remark to Arthur Lundahl, "Ten-minute reconnaissance, now that's a goal to shoot for!"
